title: Sandigan to NBI: Bring Romualdez co-accused to court
summary: The Sandiganbayan Third Division has ordered the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to bring to court on Dec. 4 Felicito Guevarra, a co-accused of former speaker Martin Romualdez in the…

blocks.text: Guevarra surrendered to the NBI on Nov. 19 after state prosecutors moved to cancel his passport.

MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division has ordered the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to bring to court on Dec. 4 Felicito Guevarra, a co-accused of former speaker Martin Romualdez in the P7.4-billion plunder case in connection with alleged kickbacks from government infrastructure projects.
He is currently in the NBI’s detention facility.
His arraignment will coincide with the last day of the hearing of Romualdez’s petition for bail.

Third Division Clerk of Court Dennis Pulma said the anti-graft court issued a produce order for the arraignment of Guevarra, president of Samchan Foreign Exchange Corp., a firm allegedly used to funnel the alleged kickbacks for Romualdez.
State prosecutors asked the court to exclude Guevarra as accused in the plunder as they seek to substitute him for former public works secretary Manuel Bonoan in the bail hearing.
The Office of the Ombudsman is seeking to make Guevarra a state witness after he returned P343 million in alleged proceeds in connection with the plunder case.
Pulma said the court has yet to issue a resolution on the motions filed by state prosecutors.
